about: Attorney Brett Kobes is the founder and owner of Kobes Legal PLLC, which has law offices in Seattle and North Bend, Washington and in Naples, Florida. A top-rated lawyer, Mr. Kobes provides exceptional counsel and support to a diverse range of clients throughout the greater Seattle metro and surrounding areas of the Puget Sound region who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Naturally competitive, Mr. Kobes played soccer and wrestled during his time at West Point Academy, where he was the latest in a long line of family members to attend the school. He also served as an Airborne Ranger with the U.S. Army, so he understands the virtues of hard work and service to others. He employs these qualities in his practice, and he has achieved considerable success helping his clients find the favorable outcomes they seek for their complex and pressing legal challenges as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible.

Among his legal credentials, Mr. Kobes received his certificate for having completed the ISO 27001 Foundations Course, and he holds his certification as an ISO 27001 Lead Implementer. He has become a recognized authority on data privacy and information security. He also holds his MBA, and he uses his considerable business acumen to better understand the business side of law and how the employers in companies operate to help maximize results for his clients.

In 2018, Mr. Kobes obtained his Juris Doctor from Seattle University School of Law and his Master of Business Administration from the Albers School of Business and Economics. The Washington State Bar Association admitted him to practice the following year, and he is also admitted to practice before the Snoqualmie Tribal Court and the Puyallup Tribal Court. He is also admitted to practice in Arizona and Florida State. He is an active member of the King County Bar Association and the Washington Defense Trial Lawyers, among his other professional affiliations.
